schema:
CREATE TABLE "Campaigns" ("campaign_id" INTEGER UNIQUE, "valid_from" DATE, "valid_until" DATE, "rate" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("campaign_id", "valid_from", "valid_until"), CHECK ("rate" > 0));
CREATE TABLE "Conversions" ("campaign_id" INTEGER, "event_date" DATE, "quantity" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("campaign_id") REFERENCES "Campaigns" ("campaign_id"), CHECK ("quantity" > 0));
correct_query: SELECT c.campaign_id, ROUND(CAST(SUM(v.quantity * c.rate) AS REAL) / SUM(v.quantity), 2) AS weighted_rate FROM Campaigns AS c JOIN Conversions AS v ON c.campaign_id = v.campaign_id AND v.event_date BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_until GROUP BY c.campaign_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant computes the denominator sum in a separate subquery over Conversions without filtering by the date range predicate
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT T2.campaign_id, ROUND(CAST(T1.total_weighted AS REAL) / T2.total_qty, 2) AS weighted_rate FROM (SELECT c.campaign_id, SUM(c.rate * v.quantity) AS total_weighted FROM Campaigns AS c LEFT JOIN Conversions AS v ON c.campaign_id = v.campaign_id WHERE c.valid_from <= v.event_date AND c.valid_until >= v.event_date GROUP BY c.campaign_id) AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM Conversions GROUP BY campaign_id) AS T2 ON T1.campaign_id = T2.campaign_id
